name: Airplanes
overview: Scripture uses imagery of flight and wings to convey God's sovereignty and the gathering of His people, as seen in Isaiah's depiction of nations assembled from the four corners of the earth, described metaphorically as wings (Isaiah 11:12). The vision of those who 'fly as a cloud, and as the doves to their windows' (Isaiah 60:8) reflects God's providential care and the swift movement of His purposes. Though airplanes as modern technology are not directly mentioned, these passages illustrate the biblical theme of divine oversight from above, reminding believers of God's exalted throne (Isaiah 6:1) and His attentive presence to our prayers (Psalms 102:1).
